div.head: Ine 1.1
div.ab: Æfter þam we bebeodað, þæt ealles folces æw ⁊ domas ðus syn gehealdene:
Æfter þam we bebeodað, þætte ealles folces æw ⁊ domas ðus sien gehealdene:
Postea precipimus (uolumus), ut totius populi coniugia sint et iudicia deuote conseruata.
{XLV} Æfter þam we bebeodað þætte ealles folces æw ⁊ domas ðus sien gehealdene.
Next we command that the law and judgments regarding all the folk be held as follows.
After this we command that the law and decrees affecting the whole nation be observed as follows.
After that, we enjoin that the law and decrees of all the people are to be observed thus:
Demnächst gebieten wir, dass alles [Laien]volkes Recht und Gesetze folgendermassen gehalten werden:
Next we command that the law and statutes of the whole [lay] people be kept as follows:
